value.body:
Currently, the README on the repository index page is buried below the file tree and commit log. Having to scroll down 1.5 pages doesn't seem like a good UX.

Ideally, I think we need a complete layout redesign for our repo index page, but there are a few easy fixes we can do in the meantime:

- Reduce max commit count (3~5)\
  imo 3 is enough. Github & Codeberg show only one, and honestly I haven't had any issues with that. I can still see handful of recent commits from the file tree.
- Set a max height for the file tree. Cut down long lists by default.\
  The file tree is less important than the README.
value.title: UI: make readme more accessible from repo index page.

value.body:
Workable task for [#771](https://tangled.org/tangled.org/core/issues/771).

rkey of `org.tangled.repo.declaration` should be normalized so same user cannot claim ownership with multiple names. We want to avoid this to happen:

```
at://boltless.me/org.tangled.repo.declaration/NativeVim
{ "repo": "did:plc:repo1", "createdAt": "2025-09-22T11:14:35+01:00" }
at://boltless.me/org.tangled.repo.declaration/nativevim
{ "repo": "did:plc:repo2", "createdAt": "2025-09-22T11:14:35+01:00" }
```

So rkey (slug) must be normalized. We should force them to be lowercased so only `/nativevim` here will be effective. But we also want to keep the original name with intended cases. We can keep that information under `org.tangled.repo.manifest/self` record owned by the repository itself.

```
at://did:plc:repo2/org.tangled.repo.manifest/self
{
  "owner": "did:plc:boltless",
  "name": "NativeVim",
  // ...
}
```

`.name` will be used on two-way verification but only after the normalization. In this case, we expect `at://did:plc:boltless/org.tangled.repo.declaration/nativevim` to exist and its `.repo` value point to same DID.
value.title: lexicons: `org.tangled.repo.manifest` rename `.slug` to `.name`

value.body:
Creating a repository with uppercase characters will cause the tangled ui (both current HTMX & next's svelte) to show the same name in the clone repository dropdown.

![Image](blob+at://did:web:daroche.me/bafkreihpnahdgh5ss5ecrpe4orsohuiqowog6kstzu7amcz5y3gizvwatq)

This makes the webui's SSH clone url unusable unless lowercased by the user, as knot2 refers to repositories by their record id rather than their Name.

Reproducer :

```
$ git ls-remote git@tangled.org:daroche.me/UppercaseTest-tangled
knot: repository not found
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.

Please make sure you have the correct access rights
and the repository exists.

$ git ls-remote git@tangled.org:daroche.me/uppercasetest-tangled
04e11257596fe699e6fdae15361f22364770fe99        HEAD
04e11257596fe699e6fdae15361f22364770fe99        refs/heads/main
```
value.title: UI : Displayed SSH clone URL doesn't account for uppercase characters
